tool_input.command:
hops fg create transactions --version 1 --primary-key account_id --event-time event_time \
  --features "account_id:string,event_time:bigint,amount:double,balance:double" \
  --description "Transaction amount and balance" --if-exists get --json 2>&1 | grep -vE 'INFO:|UserWarning|compatibility|pip install|^$'

hops fg create profiles --version 1 --primary-key account_id --event-time event_time \
  --features "account_id:string,event_time:bigint,credit_score:bigint,tier:string" \
  --description "Credit score and tier" --if-exists get --json 2>&1 | grep -E '"id"|"name"|created successfully'
hops fg create activity --version 1 --primary-key account_id --event-time event_time \
  --features "account_id:string,event_time:bigint,sessions_7d:bigint" \
  --description "Sessions in last 7 days" --if-exists get --json 2>&1 | grep -E '"id"|"name"|created successfully'
hops fg create account_health --version 1 --primary-key account_id --event-time event_time \
  --features "account_id:string,event_time:bigint,health_score:double" \
  --description "Account health score" --if-exists get --json 2>&1 | grep -E '"id"|"name"|created successfully'
hops fg create labels --version 1 --primary-key account_id --event-time label_time \
  --features "account_id:string,label_time:bigint,churned:bigint" \
  --description "Churn labels spine" --if-exists get --json 2>&1 | grep -E '"id"|"name"|created successfully'
tool_input.description: Create profiles, activity, account_health, labels feature groups

tool_input.command: hops fg insert transactions --version 1 --file data/transactions.csv 2>&1 | grep -vE 'INFO:|UserWarning|compatibility|pip install|^$' | tail -15
hops fg insert transactions --version 1 --file data/transactions_late.csv 2>&1 | grep -vE 'INFO:|UserWarning|compatibility|pip install|^$' | tail -5

hops fg insert profiles --version 1 --file data/profiles.csv 2>&1 | grep -E '✓ Inserted'
hops fg insert activity --version 1 --file data/activity.csv 2>&1 | grep -E '✓ Inserted'
hops fg insert account_health --version 1 --file data/account_health.csv 2>&1 | grep -E '✓ Inserted'
hops fg insert labels --version 1 --file data/labels.csv 2>&1 | grep -E '✓ Inserted'

hops fv create churntraining579f5f --version 1 \
  --feature-group labels:1 \
  --join "transactions:1 LEFT account_id" \
  --join "profiles:1 LEFT account_id" \
  --join "activity:1 LEFT account_id" \
  --join "account_health:1 LEFT account_id" \
  --labels churned --json 2>&1 | grep -vE 'INFO:|UserWarning|compatibility|pip install|^$'
